STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA

NC DIVISION OF MOTOR VEHICLES

J.R. "JOEY" HOPKINS

GOVERNOR

3118 MAIL SERVICE CNTR RALEIGH, N.C. 27699-3118

(919) 715-7000

08/01/2025

OFFICIAL NOTICE

CUSTOMER NO.

YOUR NORTH CAROLINA DRIVING PRIVILEGE HAS BEEN SCHEDULED FOR SUSPENSION IN ACCORDANCE WITH GENERAL STATUTE 20-16(a)(10) FOR SPEEDING OVER 75 MPH.

EFFECTIVE DATE: 12:01 A.M., 08/11/2025

SCHEDULED SUSPENSION END DATE: 09/10/2025

REQUIREMENTS:

YOU CANNOT DRIVE A MOTOR VEHICLE IN THE STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA DURING THE SUSPENSION PERIOD.

HEARING PROVISIONS:

A HEARING IS NOT AUTHORIZED BY STATUTE.

REINSTATEMENT PROCEDURES:

A RESTORATION FEE OF $83.50 IS NEEDED AND HAS TO BE PAID TO THE DIVISION OF MOTOR VEHICLES BEFORE YOUR NORTH CAROLINA DRIVING PRIVILEGE CAN BE REINSTATED.

UPON PAYMENT OF THE REQUIRED RESTORATION FEE, YOUR NORTH CAROLINA DRIVING PRIVILEGE WILL BE REINSTATED, PROVIDED THERE ARE NO OTHER SUSPENSIONS IN EFFECT AT THAT TIME.

THIS ORDER IS IN ADDITION TO AND DOES NOT SUPERSEDE ANY PRIOR ORDER ISSUED BY THE DIVISION OF MOTOR VEHICLES. IF ADDITIONAL INFORMATION CONCERNING THIS ORDER IS NEEDED, YOU MAY CONTACT A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE DIVISION AT (919)715-7000.

DIRECTOR OF CUSTOMER COMPLIANCE SERVICES
